snippet.title: Decklings Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3715790?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=post

Start your own pirate crew and tame Decklings as you explore the uncharted islands in this card management deck-building game. Collect resources, craft recipes, and train your Decklings to engage in challenging card-based battles to become the Pirate Champion!
